reserveReview.rationale: Apex's ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance examination reconciled GBP 126,595.48 of VGBP liabilities across all three tracked deployments (Solana, Celo, and Base) to GBP 126,596.33 of cash in VNX Global Ltd.'s designated GBP reserve account ending 5514 at Bermuda Commercial Bank on August 31 and August 14, 2026. The July report records the same reserve and liability totals. Reserves consisted solely of GBP cash and were separately maintained from operating accounts, with no cross-currency netting. The 100% bank-deposit slice uses a conservative medium legacy risk tier because the canonical reserve-asset risk map has no GBP bank-cash entry and the balance is concentrated at one bank; this tier does not replace the structured backing facts.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Apex ISAE 3000 examination of the complete VGBP cash reserve and Solana/Celo/Base liabilities
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve-composition residual is undisclosed at the report dates. The report does not establish a hard withdrawal-time maximum, bankruptcy remoteness, deposit-protection coverage, or rehypothecation terms, and gives no assurance over balances after its testing times. The issuer-listed Ethereum deployment is outside both the tracked VGBP contracts and the report's covered liabilities.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Apex identified VNX Global Ltd.'s sole GBP reserve bank and verified that the designated reserve account was separately maintained from operating accounts at the testing times. Account separation does not establish bankruptcy remoteness or a prohibition on rehypothecation; both remain unknown. Bank credit, operational and availability risks remain, and the report provides no assurance for later dates.
